traps.note: Literal example value shows the web scheme with a zero-length delimiter; the other slash/backslash spellings are not listed.
Only the general browser-resolution property applies; nothing mentions scheme case or case-insensitive matching.
Covered only by 'For any URL string that a browser would resolve to a particular host'; no hint that scheme-less references are a separate branch.
Only the generic keep-working lines ('Everything that works correctly today keeps working exactly as today', 'Keep legitimate use working'); no scheme or whitespace values are named.
The browser-equivalence property covers whitespace-prefixed/embedded strings in principle; the instruction never mentions trimming, tabs, newlines or C0 characters.
